content: Hara qoncethan ba kushen wadha wodoro oykida issi asi be7as.
Taani, “Neeni aw bay?” yaagada oychas. I zaaridi, “Taani Yerusalaame dalgatethaynne adussatethay ay meleko wadhanaw bayis” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, taara haasaya kiitanchoy keyidi bis; iyara gahetanaw hara kiitanchoy yis.
Yida kiitanchoy, “Woxa bada, na7atetha addiyako, ‘Yerusalaamen daro asinne daro mehey daana gisho, katamaa yuushon gimbe dirsi koshshenna.
Taani iya yuushuwan tama dirsi gidana; taani iyaw boncho gidana’ yaagees Goday.
“Taani hintena biitta oyddu baggaa laallida gisho, yaape keyite; elle keyite; pudeha bagga biittafe baqatite” yaagees Goday.
“Neno, Xiyoone keya; Babiloone macca nayta giddon de7iyare, enta giddofe baqata” yaagees Goday.
Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday iya bonchuwa qoncisana mela, ba asaa bonqida kawotethatako tana kiittidi, “Hintena bochiya uray iya ayfiya buluwa bochees.
Taani ta kushiya enta bolla denthana; enta aylleti enta zaaridi bonqana. He wode hinte Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday tana kiittidaysa erana.”
“Taani yada hinte giddon daana gisho, Xiyoone asaw, zamarite; ufaytite!” yaagees Goday.
He wode daro kawotethati Godaara gahetidi iya ase gidana. I hinte giddon daana; Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday tana hinteko kiittidaysa he wode hinte erana.
Geeshsha biittan Yihuda, bana gakida gisho oothidi laattana; Yerusalaame zaaridi doorana.
Goday ba de7iya geeshsha bessan dendida gisho, asho ma77ida ubbay iya sinthan si77i go!
